title: I keep dreaming the U.S. gets hit by a nuke...
content: Hey Everyone, Was wondering if anyone here's been experiencing anything similar... So, for about the last 3 weeks (maybe a bit longer) I've been having dreams of nukes hitting the U.S. The theme of the dream is always the same. I'm laying in bed asleep, and wake up to the sound of blasts in the distance, followed by an air raid siren. The dreams do sometimes have minor differences - sometimes the air raid siren comes first, then the distant booms, other times the booms come first and are followed by the siren. And last night I had the dream again and it was just one huge blast, followed by unbelievably bright white light beaming through the windows (despite the fact that in the dream it's nighttime, this was like a bomb blast lighting everything up) And in the dreams, it's honestly terrifying. Just curious to know if anyone else has been experiencing anything similar or has any thoughts/feelings to share. Hope you're all well.
